items.t: Heavy oil burning on the 2.4L engine
items.job: Replace pistons and rings
items.note: Often free or reduced under Toyota warranty enhancement ZE7 if the car qualifies.

items.t: Engine computer can crack and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace engine control module

items.t: Passenger airbag inflator can rupture, 2003-2008 (Takata recall)
items.job: Replace passenger airbag inflator

items.t: Passenger airbag inflator can rupture, 2009-2013 (Takata recall)
items.job: Replace passenger airbag inflator

items.t: Rod knock and sudden engine failure
items.job: Replace engine with used or remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report total bills of about $4,000-$5,000 at shops; a used engine costs less.

items.t: Oil burning on the 1.8L engine
items.job: Replace pistons and rings
items.note: Many owners just top up oil and change it more often instead of rebuilding.

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with used or remanufactured unit

items.t: Manual transmission bearing noise or popping out of gear
items.job: Rebuild manual transmission with new bearings

items.t: Clutch wearing out early
items.job: Replace clutch kit and resurface flywheel

items.t: Whining from the rear differential (AWD)
items.job: Replace rear differential

items.t: Squeal or rattle from the drive belt tensioner
items.job: Replace drive belt tensioner and belt

items.t: Check engine light for misfire or lean codes
items.job: Replace intake manifold gasket or airflow sensor
items.note: Samarins lists $120-$280 at a shop for the gasket and $120-$150 for an OEM airflow sensor.

items.t: Check engine light for catalyst efficiency (P0420)
items.job: Replace catalytic converter

items.t: Starter motor failure
items.job: Replace starter motor

items.t: Airbags may deploy without a crash (recall)
items.job: Install airbag control module noise filter or replace module

items.t: Door glass can come loose from the window regulator (recall)
items.job: Re-secure door glass to regulator with new bolts

items.t: Sticking accelerator pedal (recall)
items.job: Install pedal reinforcement or replace pedal

items.t: Floor mat can trap the gas pedal (recall)
items.job: Reshape pedal and replace floor mats

items.t: Driver's power window switch can overheat (recall)
items.job: Grease or replace power window master switch

items.t: Airbag light from a damaged steering wheel cable (recall)
items.job: Replace steering wheel spiral cable

items.t: Hard brake pedal in extreme cold (recall)
items.job: Replace brake booster vacuum port

items.t: Electric power steering drifts or wanders
items.job: Replace steering column with power steering motor
items.note: Toyota offered a free fix for many affected cars; ask a dealer first.

items.t: Brief rattle at cold start from the cam timing gear
items.job: Replace intake cam timing (VVT) gear

items.t: Coolant leak from stripped head bolt threads
items.job: Install head bolt thread inserts and new head gasket

items.t: Water pump leak or noise
items.job: Replace water pump, belt and refill coolant

items.t: Oil leak from the timing chain cover
items.job: Reseal timing chain cover

items.t: Misfire from a failed ignition coil
items.job: Replace ignition coil and spark plugs

items.t: Alternator stops charging
items.job: Replace alternator

items.t: Wheel bearing hum
items.job: Replace one wheel bearing/hub

items.t: Rear brakes wearing early or calipers sticking
items.job: Service rear brakes and replace a seized caliper

items.t: Airbags may not deploy in some crashes (recall)
items.job: Install noise filter on airbag control unit
